caption: Problem 1: jugs A 21, B 127, C 3. Goal: 100 quarts. Fill B.
Pour B into A until A is full: B has 127 − 21 = 106.
Empty A. The 21 quarts are removed from B: B − A.
Pour B into C until C is full: B has 106 − 3 = 103.
Empty C. This removes one C-sized amount: B − A − C.
Pour B into C again: B now holds 103 − 3 = 100. Goal reached: B − A − 2C = 100.
Problem 8: jugs A 28, B 59, C 3. Goal: 25 quarts. Fill A.
Pour A into C until C is full: A has 28 − 3 = 25. Goal reached: A − C = 25, a simpler two-jug route.
